scenarios.name: Choose and restore annotation scale for an active view

scenario_steps.name: an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
a copied view representation is active
the user opens the active view's context menu and expands Annotation Scale
fixed ratios and Custom are available
the user reopens the Annotation Scale submenu
the user reopens the Annotation Scale submenu
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto
the user opens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu
the Edit Annotation Scale dialog opens with Auto selected
the user replaces the scale with "3:2"
the user reopens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto
the user opens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu
the user replaces the scale with "3:2"
the user reopens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu
the Custom entry displays the equivalent decimal value 1.50

scenarios.name: Correct an invalid custom annotation scale

scenario_steps.name: an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto
the Edit Annotation Scale dialog is open
the user replaces the scale with "0"
the user replaces the scale with "1:0"
the user replaces the scale with "abc"
the user replaces the scale with "3:2"
the scale text returns to its normal color
